items.title: Qinghai–Tibet Plateau study traces evolution of terrestrial animals across three distinct regions
items.summary: A new study has pieced together the evolutionary history of terrestrial animals on the Qinghai–Tibet Plateau (QTP), offering a comprehensive picture of how the distinctive fauna of the "Third Pole" took shape over millions of years.

items.title: The human surfaceome: AI flags potential cell surface drug targets overlooked by major databases
items.summary: More than 65% of approved medicines work by binding to proteins on the surface of human cells. Yet scientists developing new treatments face a fundamental problem: Major biological databases disagree about which proteins are actually found on cell surfaces.
